from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNetProfit(BaseModel):
    """Extracted Net Profit or Net Loss data from a single company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as named in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the document for this line item (e.g., 'Net Loss', 'Net Income')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported")
    scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount as stated in the document (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[CompanyNetProfit]
